info.title: Aurik Equipment Monitoring API
info.description:
Ingests machine data from three vendors with inconsistent schemas plus the internal CMMS work-order feed, normalizes
it into one canonical model
**asynchronously**, and serves an **explainable machine operational attention view** plus plant/line summaries.

* **Ingestion** returns `202` + `batch_id` immediately; poll `/v1/batches/{id}`.
* **Validation**: envelopes are validated synchronously (4xx); record values asynchronously (warn vs reject).
  Use `/v1/ingest/{vendor}/validate` for a synchronous dry run.
* **Errors** always have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?, "request_id"?}}`.
* **Auth**: send `X-API-Key` when the server runs with `API_KEYS` set.
* **Dashboard**: separate static app in `frontend/` (http://localhost:8080 with Docker Compose).

post.description: Accepts a PulseForge envelope with a non-empty `events` list. Returns **202** with a `batch_id` immediately; normalization and state derivation run asynchronously - poll `status_url`. Re-sending an identical body returns **200** with the original batch (`replayed: true`). Record *values* are validated asynchronously (warn vs reject).

post.summary: Dry-run validate a PulseForge batch (nothing stored)
post.description: Runs envelope validation and full per-record normalization synchronously and reports, for every record, whether it would be valid / valid with warnings / rejected and whether it would be stored as new, duplicate or a revision.

accepted_records.title: Accepted Records
accepted_records.description: Stored and queued for async processing

duplicate_records.title: Duplicate Records
duplicate_records.description: Same id + identical payload as an already stored record

revised_records.title: Revised Records
revised_records.description: Same id, different payload -> new revision (latest wins)

replayed.title: Replayed
replayed.description: True when the identical request was already received (HTTP 200)

reason_codes.title: Reason Codes
reason_codes.description: Codes with level >= 1, most severe first

state_version.title: State Version
state_version.description: Increments only when the derived content changes

technician_note.title: Technician Note
technician_note.description: Free text (keywords such as 'leak', 'stall' raise attention)

data_age_seconds.title: Data Age Seconds
data_age_seconds.description: Age of the newest event (event time), at read time

last_received_at.title: Last Received At
last_received_at.description: When data for this machine last arrived (receive time)

line_id.title: Line Id
line_id.description: Line reported by vendor; asset reference wins on mismatch

sensor_health.title: Sensor Health
sensor_health.description: 0..1; below 0.6 is treated as poor signal quality

productionLine.title: Productionline
productionLine.description: Short line code, e.g. A -> LINE-A

timestampMs.title: Timestampms
timestampMs.description: Epoch milliseconds (epoch seconds tolerated with a warning) (required)

vibration_g.title: Vibration G
vibration_g.description: Vibration acceleration, g (not converted to mm/s)

work_order_id.title: Work Order Id
work_order_id.description: Work order id - idempotency key; a status change is a new revision (required)

plant_id.title: Plant Id
plant_id.description: Plant reported by the CMMS; asset reference wins on mismatch
